_comment: Plan O7 / OBS-SEC-1. Declarative folder access for the provisioned dashboard folders (title = sub-directory of provisioning/dashboards/json). Applied idempotently by apply-folder-permissions.py (compose service grafana-access-init). Permission: View, Edit or Admin. A role not listed has NO access; the Admin org role always has it. Grafana OSS has no provisioning file for permissions, so the Grafana HTTP API is the provisioning mechanism.
